hypothesis: M206 improves fixed objective and broad retention gates but fails the protected key because the key moves outside the pre-registered boundary acceptance window. Before any more PPO, the failure mode must be audited and the next guarded retry must be specified.
success_criteria: do not run PPO or actor updates in this milestone
inspect runs/m206_critical_key_seed9944 guard results and candidate CSVs
compare M204 and M206 on protected key 9944|perturbed|28|28
identify whether the failure is caused by boundary-window excursion, lost normal success, lost wrong-history sensitivity, or missing candidate rows
keep M204 as current-best unless the audit justifies a pre-registered retry
write a concrete next-step manifest before any further training
failure_criteria: change protected-key thresholds after seeing the result without a design note
promote M206 based on fixed objective, behavior, or replay gates while protected-key acceptance is false
discard the protected key without replacing it with an equal or stronger pre-registered guard

commands.name: m207_protected_key_audit
commands.command: Inspect runs/m206_critical_key_seed9944/guard_results.csv and m206_stage6_candidates.csv against the reference manifest thresholds.

commands.name: m207_next_design
commands.command: Write the audited diagnosis and choose either a guarded stage6 retry from M204 or a protected-key-aware objective/config adjustment.

decision_rule: No further PPO is allowed until this audit records the protected-key failure mechanism and pre-registers the next guarded action.
